nodes.text: Bonus: at the onset of these rumors, I had a chance to speak with NDTV to try and offer some clarity. I explained how these stories were largely unfounded, how the rise in #HMPV cases was nothing out of the ordinary for winter, and how the Chinese CDC’s update was simply routine https://t.co/RLGzV2GH0q
